summary: A short biographical note on Raeanne Presley, an American Republican politician who served four terms as Mayor of Branson, Missouri. It notes her earlier service as a Branson alderman, an earlier mayoral election loss to Lou Schaeffer in the mid-1990s, and her 2015 defeat for re-election by Karen Best.
one_line: Raeanne Presley is a Republican politician who served four terms as mayor of Branson, Missouri, before losing to Karen Best in 2015.
key_facts: Raeanne Presley is an American politician of the Republican Party.
Raeanne Presley served four terms as Mayor of Branson, Missouri.
Raeanne Presley previously served as an alderman in Branson.
Raeanne Presley lost an election for mayor to Lou Schaeffer in the mid-1990s.
Raeanne Presley was defeated for re-election in 2015.
Karen Best defeated Raeanne Presley in the 2015 mayoral re-election.
Karen Best is the current mayor of Branson, as stated in the note.
